meta.note: Gold Brain answer for video / OB / live-stream studios

site_story_summary.audience: Brands, broadcasters, and event organisers who need production-grade video and live delivery
site_story_summary.story: A regional studio that owns the full path from brief to broadcast — outside broadcast, live streaming, corporate film, and commercials — with one crew and broadcast standards.
site_story_summary.offer: Outside broadcasting, live streaming, corporate video, TV commercials
gaps: Hero must not lead with an SEO niche title
Services should read as outcomes (sport, conference, launch) not only kit lists

after.executive_summary: This studio already has proof (years in market, OB and stream capability). The commercial gap is clarity on the first screen: who they hire for, what form of production fits, and one decisive CTA. Pitch a Growth engagement that tightens hero messaging, service cards, and enquiry conversion — keep the cinematic craft, remove SEO-title heroes and vague Contact CTAs.

priority_actions.title: Lead with a benefit promise, not the SEO page title
priority_actions.why: First-time buyers decide in seconds whether this is the crew for their live or film job.
priority_actions.how: Replace browser-title heroes with a broadcast outcome line plus one primary CTA (e.g. Start a project).

priority_actions.title: Make services scannable as production forms
priority_actions.why: Buyers think in jobs (stadium OB, conference stream, launch film) — not long paragraphs.
priority_actions.how: Four cards: Outside broadcast, Live streaming, Corporate film, Commercials — each with who it is for and a deep link.

priority_actions.title: Put proof next to the offer
priority_actions.why: Studios win on trust: years, return clients, resolution, crew continuity.
priority_actions.how: Surface 20+ years / productions delivered / broadcast-quality near the hero or process rail.

priority_actions.title: Keep media cinematic but light on mobile
priority_actions.why: Heavy heroes kill mobile enquiry rates even when desktop looks premium.
priority_actions.how: Compressed still + optional reel on interaction; defer autoplay weight below the fold.

quick_wins: Rewrite H1 to a benefit promise
Change primary CTA to Start a project / Request a quote
Add three proof stats above the fold
Label services as forms of work (OB / Stream / Film / Commercial)
strategic_improvements: Cinematic homepage that matches studio craft without SEO-title heroes
Case-led portfolio path: sport OB → conference stream → brand film
Enquiry form that asks service type + budget band (as on strong studio sites)
proposal_angles: Growth package: messaging + conversion path + performance pass so enquiries rise without a full rebuild.
Optional Redesign: Dora-style cinematic landing grounded in real OB/stream/film offers.
